title: finding.v1
description: One finding from a pack's run. The source of truth is findings.json in .agency/runs/<run-id>/; anything derived from it can be thrown away and rebuilt at any time.

id.description: ULID. Never autoincrement — otherwise merging two histories collides.

pack.description: Name of the pack that produced this finding — a skill in .claude/skills/agency-<name>/.

dimension.description: Which of the pack's dimensions found this. Lets precision be measured per dimension.

body.description: Markdown. The claim plus a concrete failure scenario (inputs/state → wrong output).

anchor.description: A four-layer anchor. Resolved top to bottom, stopping at the first layer that succeeds. Without it a finding points at innocent code after a few weeks and has no way to know it.

file.description: POSIX path relative to the project root. Never absolute — otherwise the run record could not be shared or committed.

commit.description: The full 40 characters. A shortened SHA can later point somewhere else without warning.

snippet.description: Layer 2. The text of the line..endLine block on the day of the analysis. The most distinctive line in it is what gets searched for — a one-line snippet fails on '/**' and similar boilerplate.

symbol.description: Layer 3, from the symbol in the graph. Survives a refactor and a moved block where a line number does not.

body.description: Layer 4. The symbol's body on the day of the analysis. A safety net for when the commit no longer exists in the clone — a squash-merge with the branch deleted is GitHub's default.

evidence.description: The deterministic gate: a finding with no evidence never becomes a candidate. This is not a text-quality filter, it is a schema — such a finding simply does not validate.

kind.description: graph = a fact from the code-graph driver (`agency graph`), rule = a rule from the project's own documentation, test-gap = missing coverage, diff = content of the change, runtime = observed behaviour, doc = contradicts the documentation

source.description: Where this came from — e.g. 'agency graph impact --depth 2' or 'CLAUDE.md#rules-that-will-bite-you'

score.description: Confidence after the false-positive filter. Below the project's threshold a finding is not published, but it stays in the run record.

fingerprint.description: Deterministic fingerprint for dedup across runs. Computed from the symbol and the normalized claim, NOT from the line number or the title — a title survives a corrected diagnosis, the content does not.

state.description: Five states. `candidate` rests only where the pack has no sink; `held` waits for the next chain member; `sent` and `rejected` are terminal; a decision event in decisions.jsonl carries who and why.

sinks.description: Where the finding propagated to. Derived destinations, not the source of truth — when a sink fails, the finding is not lost.
